Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL Database long-term retention (LTR) backup immutability

Body.Content:
You can now configure immutability for Azure SQL Database LTR backups to meet compliance and regulatory needs. Once immutability is configured, the backups can’t be edited or deleted until the specified retention expires, mitigating any potential ransomware attacks for the entire retention.  

Learn more.
